rationale: The methods remove distinct sequential low-batch decode costs: exact packed BF16 projection reduces lm_head weight traffic before token selection, while the exponential-race sampler removes general multinomial dispatch and validation after probabilities are produced. They are a transferable cross-framework composition hypothesis, not competing rewrites of the same work.
required_context: Port both methods into one serving stack; source code from two frameworks is not directly composable.
Use an unquantized BF16 lm_head that satisfies the exact-packing guard and unseeded stochastic sampling that satisfies the exponential-race guard.
Measure the production-weighted share of both stages and reject the composition when its Amdahl ceiling is below 1.02x.
Preserve the stock lm_head path, deterministic seeded sampling, and rollout controls as independent fallbacks.
falsification_recipe: Benchmark baseline, packed-lm-head-only, sampler-only, and combined arms under one model, hardware, batch distribution, and sampling policy.
Require exact packed-weight reconstruction and logits agreement for the projection path.
Use a statistical goodness-of-fit test for stochastic samples and exact equality for the seeded fallback.
Reject the composition if either guard rarely fires, one rewrite removes the other's measured share, or combined end-to-end speedup is below 1.02x.
